summary_zh: 泰國工業部派出50組團隊突擊檢查5府1,500家工廠，違規者可能遭勒令停工或吊銷許可，環保稽查壓力持續升高。另有Credit Term新規將於11月2日生效，付款期限上限為30天（農產品）或45天（商業、生產與服務），企業需重新檢視現金流。農業部則支持碾米廠推動稻穀大數據與統一標準。
summary_en: Thailand's Industry Ministry sent 50 teams to inspect 1,500 factories in 5 provinces, with possible shutdowns or licence revocation. New credit-term rules take effect Nov 2, capping payment at 30 days (agri) or 45 days (commerce, production, services). Rice mills get backing for paddy big data and unified standards.
